mapper.insert: INSERT INTO etf_five_dimension_resonance ( etf_code, etf_name, trade_date, trade_time, signal_trend_long, signal_momentum_long, signal_warning, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, amount, dif, dea, macd, is_macd_golden_state, is_macd_red, macd_hist_direction, sar_value, is_sar_bullish, sar_trend, ma5, ma10, ma20, ma30, ma60, is_ma5_above_ma10, is_ma10_above_ma20, is_close_above_ma20, is_close_above_ma60, rsi6, rsi12, rsi24, k_value, d_value, j_value, boll_mid, boll_upper, boll_lower, atr14, adx14, is_yesterday_triggered, is_today_triggered, first_triggered_date_of_year, previous_triggered_date, last_triggered_date, source, etl_batch_no ) WITH latest_day_ta AS ( SELECT t.* FROM etf_ta_indicator t INNER JOIN ( SELECT etf_code, MAX(trade_time) AS max_trade_time FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE period = 'day' AND DATE(trade_time) = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY etf_code ) latest ON latest.etf_code = t.etf_code AND latest.max_trade_time = t.trade_time WHERE t.period = 'day' ), qualified_today AS ( SELECT t.etf_code FROM etf_ta_indicator t WHERE t.period IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'season') AND t.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND t.is_macd_red = 1 AND t.is_sar_bullish = 1 AND t.trade_time = ( SELECT MAX(t2.trade_time) FROM etf_ta_indicator t2 WHERE t2.etf_code = t.etf_code AND t2.period = t.period AND DATE(t2.trade_time) <= #{tradeDate} ) GROUP BY etf_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT period) = 4 ), qualified_yesterday AS ( SELECT t.etf_code FROM etf_ta_indicator t WHERE #{previousTradeDate} IS NOT NULL AND t.period IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'season') AND t.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND t.is_macd_red = 1 AND t.is_sar_bullish = 1 AND t.trade_time = ( SELECT MAX(t2.trade_time) FROM etf_ta_indicator t2 WHERE t2.etf_code = t.etf_code AND t2.period = t.period AND DATE(t2.trade_time) <= #{previousTradeDate} ) GROUP BY etf_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT period) = 4 ), qualified_history AS ( SELECT target_date, etf_code FROM ( SELECT d.target_date, t.etf_code, t.period, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY d.target_date, t.etf_code, t.period ORDER BY t.trade_time DESC ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DATE(trade_time) AS target_date FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE period = 'day' ) d INNER JOIN etf_ta_indicator t ON t.trade_time < DATE_ADD(d.target_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND t.period IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'season') AND t.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND t.is_macd_red = 1 AND t.is_sar_bullish = 1 ) latest_period WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY target_date, etf_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT period) = 4 ) SELECT sm.etf_code, sm.symbol AS etf_name, #{tradeDate} AS trade_date, t1.trade_time, COALESCE(t1.signal_trend_long, 0) AS signal_trend_long, COALESCE(t1.signal_momentum_long, 0) AS signal_momentum_long, COALESCE(t1.signal_warning, 0) AS signal_warning, t1.open_price, t1.high_price, t1.low_price, t1.close_price, t1.volume, t1.amount, t1.dif, t1.dea, t1.macd, COALESCE(t1.is_macd_golden_state, 0) AS is_macd_golden_state, COALESCE(t1.is_macd_red, 0) AS is_macd_red, COALESCE(t1.macd_hist_direction, 0) AS macd_hist_direction, t1.sar_value, COALESCE(t1.is_sar_bullish, 0) AS is_sar_bullish, COALESCE(t1.sar_trend, 0) AS sar_trend, t1.ma5, t1.ma10, t1.ma20, t1.ma30, t1.ma60, COALESCE(t1.is_ma5_above_ma10, 0) AS is_ma5_above_ma10, COALESCE(t1.is_ma10_above_ma20, 0) AS is_ma10_above_ma20, COALESCE(t1.is_close_above_ma20, 0) AS is_close_above_ma20, COALESCE(t1.is_close_above_ma60, 0) AS is_close_above_ma60, t1.rsi6, t1.rsi12, t1.rsi24, t1.k_value, t1.d_value, t1.j_value, t1.boll_mid, t1.boll_upper, t1.boll_lower, t1.atr14, t1.adx14, CASE WHEN qy.etf_code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_yesterday_triggered, CASE WHEN qt.etf_code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_today_triggered, ( SELECT MIN(qh.target_date) FROM qualified_history qh WHERE qh.etf_code = sm.etf_code AND YEAR(qh.target_date) = YEAR(#{tradeDate}) AND qh.target_date <= #{tradeDate} ) AS first_triggered_date_of_year, ( SELECT MAX(qh.target_date) FROM qualified_history qh WHERE qh.etf_code = sm.etf_code AND qh.target_date < #{tradeDate} ) AS previous_triggered_date, ( SELECT MAX(qh.target_date) FROM qualified_history qh WHERE qh.etf_code = sm.etf_code AND qh.target_date <= #{tradeDate} ) AS last_triggered_date, COALESCE(t1.source, 'AmazingData') AS source, COALESCE(t1.etl_batch_no, CONCAT(#{latestBatchDate}, '_FIVE_DIM')) AS etl_batch_no FROM etf_security_master sm LEFT JOIN latest_day_ta t1 ON t1.etf_code = sm.etf_code LEFT JOIN qualified_today qt ON qt.etf_code = sm.etf_code LEFT JOIN qualified_yesterday qy ON qy.etf_code = sm.etf_code WHERE COALESCE(sm.is_active, 1) = 1 ORDER BY t1.close_price DESC, sm.etf_code ASC ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE etf_name = VALUES(etf_name), trade_time = VALUES(trade_time), signal_trend_long = VALUES(signal_trend_long), signal_momentum_long = VALUES(signal_momentum_long), signal_warning = VALUES(signal_warning), open_price = INSERT INTO etf_five_dimension_resonance ( etf_code, etf_name, trade_date, trade_time, signal_trend_long, signal_momentum_long, signal_warning, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, amount, dif, dea, macd, is_macd_golden_state, is_macd_red, macd_hist_direction, sar_value, is_sar_bullish, sar_trend, ma5, ma10, ma20, ma30, ma60, is_ma5_above_ma10, is_ma10_above_ma20, is_close_above_ma20, is_close_above_ma60, rsi6, rsi12, rsi24, k_value, d_value, j_value, boll_mid, boll_upper, boll_lower, atr14, adx14, is_yesterday_triggered, is_today_triggered, first_triggered_date_of_year, previous_triggered_date, last_triggered_date, source, etl_batch_no ) WITH period_intervals AS ( SELECT etf_code, period, DATE(trade_time) AS effective_date, LEAD(DATE(trade_time)) OVER ( PARTITION BY etf_code, period ORDER BY trade_time ) AS next_effective_date, is_macd_golden_state, is_macd_red, is_sar_bullish FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE period IN ('week', 'month', 'season') ), daily_signals AS ( SELECT day_ta.*, DATE(day_ta.trade_time) AS trade_date, CASE WHEN day_ta.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND day_ta.is_macd_red = 1 AND day_ta.is_sar_bullish = 1 AND week_ta.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND week_ta.is_macd_red = 1 AND week_ta.is_sar_bullish = 1 AND month_ta.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND month_ta.is_macd_red = 1 AND month_ta.is_sar_bullish = 1 AND season_ta.is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND season_ta.is_macd_red = 1 AND season_ta.is_sar_bullish = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_today_triggered FROM etf_ta_indicator day_ta INNER JOIN period_intervals week_ta ON week_ta.etf_code = day_ta.etf_code AND week_ta.period = 'week' AND day_ta.trade_time >= week_ta.effective_date AND (week_ta.next_effective_date IS NULL OR day_ta.trade_time < week_ta.next_effective_date) INNER JOIN period_intervals month_ta ON month_ta.etf_code = day_ta.etf_code AND month_ta.period = 'month' AND day_ta.trade_time >= month_ta.effective_date AND (month_ta.next_effective_date IS NULL OR day_ta.trade_time < month_ta.next_effective_date) INNER JOIN period_intervals season_ta ON season_ta.etf_code = day_ta.etf_code AND season_ta.period = 'season' AND day_ta.trade_time >= season_ta.effective_date AND (season_ta.next_effective_date IS NULL OR day_ta.trade_time < season_ta.next_effective_date) LEFT JOIN etf_security_master sm ON sm.etf_code = day_ta.etf_code WHERE day_ta.period = 'day' AND COALESCE(sm.is_active, 1) = 1 ), signal_history AS ( SELECT daily_signals.*, LAG(is_today_triggered, 1, 0) OVER ( PARTITION BY etf_code ORDER BY trade_time ) AS is_yesterday_triggered, MAX(CASE WHEN is_today_triggered = 1 THEN trade_date END) OVER ( PARTITION BY etf_code ORDER BY trade_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING ) AS previous_triggered_date, MAX(CASE WHEN is_today_triggered = 1 THEN trade_date END) OVER ( PARTITION BY etf_code ORDER BY trade_time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ) AS last_triggered_date FROM daily_signals ), result_rows AS ( SELECT signal_history.*, MIN(CASE WHEN is_today_triggered = 1 THEN trade_date END) OVER ( PARTITION BY etf_code, YEAR(trade_date) ) AS first_triggered_date_of_year FROM signal_history ) SELECT result_rows.etf_code, COALESCE(sm.symbol, result_rows.etf_code) AS etf_name, result_rows.trade_date, result_rows.trade_time, COALESCE(result_rows.signal_trend_long, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.signal_momentum_long, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.signal_warning, 0), result_rows.open_price, result_rows.high_price, result_rows.low_price, result_rows.close_price, result_rows.volume, result_rows.amount, result_rows.dif, result_rows.dea, result_rows.macd, COALESCE(result_rows.is_macd_golden_state, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.is_macd_red, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.macd_hist_direction, 0), result_rows.sar_value, COALESCE(result_rows.is_sar_bullish, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.sar_trend, 0), result_rows.ma5, result_rows.ma10, result_rows.ma20, result_rows.ma30, result_rows.ma60, COALESCE(result_rows.is_ma5_above_ma10, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.is_ma10_above_ma20, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.is_close_above_ma20, 0), COALESCE(result_rows.is_close_above_ma60, 0), result_rows.rsi6, result_rows.rsi12, result_rows.rsi24, result_rows.k_value, result_rows.d_value, result_rows.j_value, result_rows.boll_mid, result_rows.boll_upper, result_rows.boll_lower, result_rows.atr14, result_rows.adx14, result_rows.is_yesterday_triggered, result_rows.is_today_triggered, result_rows.first_triggered_date_of_year, result_rows.previous_triggered_date, result_rows.last_triggered_date, COALESCE(result_rows.source, 'AmazingData'), result_rows.etl_batch_no FROM result_rows LEFT JOIN etf_security_master sm ON
